About

180 Degrees is the world’s largest student consultancy. By recruiting and training Cambridge students, we provide consulting services to socially conscious organisations and increase their impact.

180 Degrees Consulting is the world’s largest non-profit student-driven consultancy. Our mission is to strengthen the ability of socially conscious organisations to achieve high impact with social outcomes.


Through 180 Degrees Consulting university students are introduced to recognised consulting methodologies. We run various events throughout the year related to the combination of consulting and work for social and non-profit organisations. The highlight is our yearly flagship project where student consultants are able to interact with non-profit organisations using knowledge gained throughout the program and at university.


What do you gain from the projects?

  • Real life consulting experience while studying at university
  • Working directly with worthwhile organisations to identify and overcome specific challenges they are facing
  • Contribute tangible impact to your communities and develop valuable life skills

 
You can find out more about us on our Facebook and our website. Feel free to drop us an email at cambridge.recruiting@180dc.org if you have any questions!
